mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, working_directory_relative_path, status, last_sequence_no, version, created_at, updated_at, metadata_json FROM sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId}

SELECT id, workspace_id, working_directory_relative_path, status, last_sequence_no, version, created_at, updated_at, metadata_json FROM sessions WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, workspace_id, working_directory_relative_path, status, last_sequence_no, version, created_at, updated_at, metadata_json FROM sessions WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'INTERRUPTED') ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sessions SET status = 'INTERRUPTED', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
